recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It completes the applied FHIR-50525 change on the machine-readable Group definition without duplicating the detailed responsibility rule outside the existing Notes section.
issue_request: FHIR-50525 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and asked FHIR-I to clarify the Group definition because the text about Groups acting or being acted upon collectively was ambiguous. The approved disposition kept Group as a collection not typically expected to act collectively, linked family/household exceptions to the Notes discussion, and added Notes guidance that only family/household-coded Groups may take responsibility roles such as performer, author, or witness.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged source commit 7ef14b8c57395c35f912f8932d94582850af7b4c added the Groups as Families and Households Notes section and changed the StructureDefinition metadata description. That application left the root Group element definition on the older example wording and carried Jira markup artifacts into the metadata description as literal asterisks and backslash-r/backslash-n text.
additional_context: The active source/fhir.ini resources list includes group=Group, so source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml and source/group/group-notes.xml are in the current build. The current Notes section already contains the approved SHALL NOT guidance for non-family/non-household responsibility references, and current source comments on responsibility-like references in other resources already apply comparable family/household limits. FHIR-I minutes show the issue was worked for exact language on 2025-12-01 and voted Persuasive with Mod on 2025-12-08. Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml so the StructureDefinition metadata description and root Group element definition share the clarified summary, use XML newline entities, remove literal Jira formatting artifacts, and point to group.html#group-usage where the approved family/household responsibility rule already lives. No change was made to group-notes.xml because the required Notes section is already present.
source_changes: source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml: removed literal Jira markdown/newline artifacts from StructureDefinition.description and aligned it with the approved Group summary plus Notes link.
source/group/structuredefinition-Group.xml: replaced the stale root Group element definition with the same clarified summary and pointer to the already-present group.html#group-usage Notes guidance.
